war_declared.text: {my_faction} has declared against {enemy_faction}. A regrettable necessity, and one the council reached with admirable calm.
Let it be minuted that {my_faction} never sought this war. We were merely patient until patience became a weapon.
The war on {enemy_faction} was debated at length, then settled in an hour. Now that is how councils ought to work.
Pray forgive the wait, {enemy_faction}. Good sieges, like good grudges, need time to mature.

peace_made.text: {my_faction} has agreed terms with {faction}. Peace is only war with better manners, and I intend to enjoy them.
The terms with {faction} were drafted in my study, though I shall let others take the credit for signing them.
{faction} and {my_faction} have stopped fighting. The vote was unanimous, which means nobody else read the small print.

player_joined_my_faction.text: {player} has sworn to {my_faction}. Welcome to the council, where every speech has a second meaning and every vote a first.
{player}, I am delighted you chose {my_faction}. Do sit near me next session and bring that crossbow of yours.
{player}, you are welcome in {my_faction}, though I shall wait a season before deciding whether you are an asset or an ornament.
{player} has joined {my_faction}. I shall keep my grudges in a ledger, and I have just made room for a new page.

player_left_my_faction.text: {player} has traded {my_faction} for {faction}. Many will call it betrayal. I shall simply call it an expensive mistake.
{player} has gone over to {faction}. I shall miss the company, though not the arguments, which were always so very long.
{player}, {faction} may pay you well, but it cannot buy back the seat you vacated in {my_faction}. Do enjoy the view.
{player}, I hope {faction} values your ambition as much as you value its banner. I shall keep your chair warm anyway.
{player}, I bear you no grudge. Tides retreat before they return, and I always know when the water turns.

player_granted_fief.text: {player} has been granted {fief}. I supported the motion, naturally, though I did wish my own name had been read first.
{fief} has gone to {player}. How delightful. I am sure the council weighed every merit with the care it deserves.
{player}, congratulations on {fief}. Do remember that a title is a loan, and the council is an excellent lender.
{player}, {fief} suits you. I drafted the petition myself, so you may thank me later over a very long lunch.

whisper_alliance_offer.text: {player}, {enemy_faction} grows bolder by the week. A quiet pact between us would sour their day nicely. Interested?
{player}, you dislike {rival} nearly as much as I do. Shall we arrange matters against {enemy_faction} soon?
{player}, a word on {rival}: they speak of loyalty while counting coins. I would welcome your counsel on how to stop them.
{player}, I have long admired your patience. Let us combine it with mine and see what {enemy_faction} makes of the pair of us.

my_faction_took_fief.text: {fief} now flies the banner of {my_faction}, taken from {enemy_faction} after a siege I called inevitable last session.
The gates of {fief} have opened to {my_faction}. {enemy_faction} will call it treachery. I shall call it a well-timed proposal.
{my_faction} holds {fief} at last. {enemy_faction} will sulk for a week, and I intend to make it a fortnight.
{fief} is ours. Let {enemy_faction} draft its objections; the council has already filed them under amusing.

player_took_my_fief.text: {player} marched into {fief} while our attention wandered. I shall not forget who held the gate and who opened it.
{fief} changed hands today, with {player} holding the keys. The council will hear of it, and at considerable length.
{player}, you have {fief} now. Enjoy the rents while they last, because I intend to call the next motion on them.
{player}, well played on {fief}. I shall pretend I expected it, which is the only dignified response open to me.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Ser {player}, a pact against {enemy_faction} suits me well. Let us have {rival} wondering which of us is smiling first.
Very well, {player}. I accept. We shall see whether {enemy_faction} can survive the arithmetic of two patient allies.
Agreed, {player}. I have waited an age for someone to say that, and {rival} will hate the sound of it.
I accept your terms, {player}. Keep them in writing, as I do, and we shall get on splendidly against {enemy_faction}.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No, {player}. I have heard your sort of offer before, and {rival} made it to me with a smile much like yours.
I must decline, {player}. The timing is poor, and I do not yet know whose cause you are truly serving.
Not today, {player}, though I am flattered you asked. Come back when the council has finished its tiresome business.
I refuse, {player}. Let {rival} keep their friends; I shall keep my own and count them with some care.

ambient_chatter.text: The rain over {town} has been relentless, and I have yet to find a sound reason for it. Perhaps the council caused it.
Has anyone else noticed the toll on the road past {village} rose again? Curious timing, I think, for such a quiet season.
The market in {town} smells of tallow and gossip this morning. I bought a little of each, for future reference.
A fine evening for a walk around {town}, the sort where one overhears things worth remembering. :)
